3240-6462-6798-8347.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1084-4279-6634.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-6634.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-6634.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

883-4279-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-4279-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2292-2459-3184.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Repeat.
2034-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

3532-5078-7010-7719.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1368-1563-6321-6633.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-6321-6633.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6097-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6097-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

141-2438-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

3259-5722-7297.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-7297.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1251-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2557-4682-4772-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2557-4682-4772-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season and Parallel Lives.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2557-4682-4772-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2999-3490-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-3490-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

934-1399-1606-6984.notablePrerequisites: Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it. You control at least three creatures.
934-1399-1606-6984.description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo, Waking Haven.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat

147-6797-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

2173-2932-5220-6798.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2932-5220-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
2173-2932-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

4616-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

413-2866-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

719-2921-4338.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

465-803-3742-4251-6791.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5231-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
5231-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5231-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2793-3743-4067-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
851-2793-3743-4067-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

64-372-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

224-4753-5196.notablePrerequisites:
At least one basic land in hand.
Clever Impersonator is a copy of Retreat to Coralhelm.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-4753-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability, putting a basic land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Retreat to Coralhelms trigger.
In response, activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Let the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger resolve, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's last ability, returning any basic land you control from the battlefield to your hand.
Let the second Retreat trigger resolve, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

1110-3490-4050-4369.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
1110-3490-4050-4369.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to an opponent equal to the creature's power.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

678-2034-4871-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
678-2034-4871-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing an additional artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

618-1770-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the first champion trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the second champion trigger, exiling the Lightning Crafter token.
When the Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

224-1119-1737-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Prototype Portal.
Prototype Portal does not have summoning sickness.
224-1119-1737-4832.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by tapping it, creating a token copy of Tree of Tales.
When the Tree of Tales token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

914-4307-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Your opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
An opponent is unable to block Yuriko.
Yuriko does not have summoning sickness.
914-4307-5241.description:
Declare Yuriko as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
Activate Sakashima's Student's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Yuriko to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Dockside Extortionist.
Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate at least four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Activate Yuriko's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Sakashim'a Student to your hand, putting Yuriko from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1064-1242-1424.notablePrerequisites:
Born to Drive and Presence of Gond attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
1064-1242-1424.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

251-1494-2334.notablePrerequisites: Denry Klin has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
251-1494-2334.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Sage of Hours.
Soulherder's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Sage of Hours enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

190-3752.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Phage and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Phage.
Each opponent's Phage enters the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

2615-3432-3799.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
Any opponent chosen with Stuffy Doll.
2615-3432-3799.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition targeting the opponent chosen with Stuffy Doll, exchanging their life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Star of Extinction for {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to all creatures and planeswalkers.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing 20 damage to that same opponent.

3965-4691.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 3 or greater.
3965-4691.description:
Activate Vilis by paying {B} and 2 life, targeting any creature.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Curse of Fool's Wisdom triggers twice.
Resolve a Curse of Fool's Wisdom trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
3965-4691.notes: You must remove Vilis or Curse of Fool's Wisdom at some point or you will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. Alternatively, you can use other cards like Ormos, Archive Keeper to get around this.
